method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate. A layer beside baseline-2026-10 and naive-2026-10, which stay unchanged.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 232, compilation date 1 July 2026 (register id C2026C00336, in 6 volumes), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A04121.txt, with the s 1237AAB(6) formula from ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A04121.formulas.md; amendments commencing on or after 20 September 2026 may be missing (no registered compilation in the deposit). The indexed small debt amount (s 1237AAA, indexed from 1 July 2026), the base interest rate (s 1229D) and the Minister's s 1237AAB(6) interest rate are inputs.

scope: Social security debts, Chapter 5: whether a payment makes a debt (s 1223(1), (1AA)-(1AG), (1B), (1C), (2), (9)); joint and several liability (s 1224AB); the 10% penalty (s 1228B(1)-(5)); the debt notice and due day (s 1229(1)-(2)); interest charge, its rate, accrual and exemptions (ss 1229A, 1229B, 1229C(3), 1229D, 1229E, 1229F); methods of recovery (s 1230C(1)-(3)); non-recovery of small amounts (s 1230D); deductions and reduction to nil (s 1231(1A), (1AA), (1B), (2)); garnishee timing and the cap on a specified amount (s 1233(1)(e), (2), (4)); repayment arrangements (s 1234(1A), (4)); no time limit (s 1234B); write-off (s 1236(1A)-(1C), (3)); waiver for administrative error and underestimated property (s 1237A), offence (s 1237AA), small debt (s 1237AAA), settlements, 80% recovery and part-payment with the present-value floor (s 1237AAB), unclaimed parenting payment (s 1237AAC(4)-(6)), special circumstances (s 1237AAD). Out: the special debt heads (ss 1223(7)-(8), 1223A, 1223AA-1224B, 1224D-1224EA, 1227-1228A), s 1224C (needs the Data-matching Program (Assistance and Tax) Act 1990, not deposited), ss 1229(3), 1233(1)(f)-(g), (3)-(8), 1234(2)-(3), 1236(2), 1237(1)-(2) (see NOTES.md), ss 1230, 1230A, 1234A, 1234AA, 1236A, 1237AAC(1)-(3), 1237AAE, 1237AB, Part 5.5, review and appeal.
seat: the person said to owe the debt (the debtor), usually a person who received a social security payment: 'Do I owe this, how much, by when, what can be done to recover it, and can it be waived?'
focus: debts (the provisions a person meets when a social security debt is raised)
